caption: The drawing depicts a decorative hair comb with five prongs. The upper portion of the comb features an ornate, semi-circular design comprised of stylized floral and foliate patterns. Three prominent flowers, each with five petals colored in a yellow-orange hue and decorated with small white dots, are integrated into the pattern—one large flower in the center and two smaller ones on either side. The surrounding foliage is rendered in dark brown, with swirling vines and leaves that fill the space in an intricate manner. The outer edge of the semi-circular section is bordered by a band that is also colored in yellow-orange and decorated with a sequence of white dots. The prongs of the comb are solid and evenly spaced, extending downward from the decorative upper portion. The background is plain and uncolored, and the drawing is outlined with a faint rectangular border. The artist's name "Yulita Westfall" appears in small letters at the bottom left.
title: Comb
